sources.title: CNS Laboratory of Memory and Brain – Director, Christine N. Smith, Ph.D.
sources.text: Cognitive Neuroscience My focus is understanding the biological bases of learning and memory. I use cognitive tests and neuroimaging to learn about human memory. My goal is to better understand the brain and how it is affected by injury, disease, and aging.
